title: An estimate line keeps its inactive part; Edit Part Request opens with its bins and a price change saves
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. The seeded estimate at Staging Heavy Duty holds QAPL-I1 on a line (added before QAPL-I1 was deactivated); note QAPL-I1's description, the line's sell price, quantity and the estimate total. DevTools Network tab open.
custom_steps:
1. Open the estimate and its Parts tab.
  2. Click the QAPL-I1 request.
  3. In Network, open the part lookup request sent when the dialog opened (inventory-parts-as-options-with-remaining-catalogue-parts with inventoryPartId).
  4. Change the sell price (e.g. add 1.00) and click Save & Close.
  5. Reload the estimate and open the line.
  6. Open the QAPL-I1 request again, change the quantity and the notes, and click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
1. QAPL-I1 is listed on its line; no "Failed to load part request data." error.
  2. "Edit Part Request" opens with no error, shows QAPL-I1's bins and reads "Selected Part {QAPL-I1's description}".
  3. 200; the response includes QAPL-I1 with is_active false.
  4. The request saves with no error or inactive refusal; the dialog closes.
  5. The line still holds QAPL-I1 with the new sell price; the line and estimate totals are recalculated.
  6. Saves with no refusal; the line still holds QAPL-I1 and the totals recalculate with the new quantity.
